mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.color, t.created_at FROM tags t INNER JOIN post_tags pt ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT id, name, slug, color, created_at FROM tags ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (name, slug, color, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{color}, NOW())
